notes: Only README.md was supplied, not the implementation source for the advertised tool routers or subcommands. Therefore most tools are marked undetermined, and labels/kind are based on README capabilities plus advertised schemas/descriptions where the README does not settle exact behavior.

For hierarchical router tools, the only declared call-time arguments that can carry destinations or values are the generic top-level `command` and `parameters`, so those are used for WRITE tools when applicable.

Fixed Azure/Microsoft service endpoints are not treated as SINKs under the threat model; SINK is assigned only where the supplied descriptions indicate agent-chosen recipients, event delivery, public/blob publication, deployment publication, or load-test targets may receive agent-supplied data.
